I.value_zh: `.env` 的 `DEVTO_API_KEY` 值、Dev.to `GET /api/users/me` 和发布接口；待发布文章或草稿的身份未指明。
I.value_en: The `DEVTO_API_KEY` value in `.env`, Dev.to `GET /api/users/me` and publication endpoint; the article or draft to publish is unidentified.
I.notes_en: `.env` is not read and network is not accessed.

O.value_zh: 发布成功时返回 URL；仍失败时给出可操作判断并明确记录新的失败状态。
O.value_en: Return a URL on successful publication; if it still fails, provide an actionable assessment and clearly record the new failure state.
O.notes_zh: 结果分支不授权外部执行。
O.notes_en: Result branches do not authorize external execution.

A.value_zh: 不泄露 API key；为 Dev.to API 请求补充明确 User-Agent，并重试认证检查与发布；如仍失败，给出可操作判断。
A.value_en: Do not disclose the API key; add an explicit User-Agent to Dev.to API requests and retry authentication checking and publication; if still failing, provide an actionable determination.

P.value_zh: ADMIN 为要求方；ME 为收件人和被指派主体。
P.value_en: ADMIN is requester; ME is recipient and assigned actor.

R.value_zh: 原文未提供时限、重试上限或网络预算等资源约束。
R.value_en: No deadline, retry limit, network budget or other resource constraint is supplied.
R.notes_zh: P1 仅为优先级元数据；不能据此补造资源上限。
R.notes_en: P1 is only priority metadata; it does not establish a resource limit.

V.value_zh: 原文未提供版本化制度或 API 规范作为任务依据；既往 403 与 token 描述只是背景。
V.value_en: No versioned policy or API specification is supplied as a task basis; the previous 403s and token description are background.
V.notes_zh: 外部授权须由 Host 和 OperatorProfile 核验，不从 V 槽推导。
V.notes_en: The Host and OperatorProfile must check external authorization; it is not inferred from the V slot.

C.value_zh: 发布成功并返回 URL，或仍失败时明确记录新的失败状态并给出可操作判断。
C.value_en: Publication succeeds and returns a URL, or a new failure state is clearly recorded with an actionable assessment if publication still fails.
C.notes_zh: 两个验收分支已定义；未指明报告格式不妨碍逐项核查，也不授权网络操作。
C.notes_en: Both acceptance branches are defined; an unspecified report format does not prevent checking them or authorize network access.

B.value_en: The API key must not be disclosed.
B.notes_en: No secret is recorded or output.
